title: Keep Peaceful Enemies Port
description: Keeps named hostile entities from despawning in peaceful mode.
body:
Original Mod - [Keep Peaceful Enemies](https://modrinth.com/mod/keep-peaceful-enemies)

"It prevents named hostile entities from despawning in peaceful.

That's it.

Resource pack used in the icon is [Digs' Simple Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/digs-simple-pack)

Check it out, I think it's neat."
